# Native Vector Replacement Fixtures

These fixed synthetic variants of the pinned schema-2 adapted React fixture are
generated by the suite installed-package verifier, not a new live server capture.
`input.shard` adds one vector. `replacement.shard` exchanges two retained chunk
coordinates without changing IDs. `capture.json` binds both exact archives and
the unreleased Core candidates. Never overwrite published immutable fixtures.

The same bytes exercise installed Core and PostgreSQL repeat replacement,
retained references, rollback and clean-destination vector export. These tests
do not qualify native member-pointer transfer, concurrency, authenticated routes,
or full cross-runtime parity. Publication/pins remain open; suite NO-GO remains.
